title: Array as a string
description: Create in the exercise base a method called `public static String arrayAsString(int[][] array)`. It should create a string representation of the array it receives as the parameter and return it.

paragraphs: Create in the exercise base a method called `public static String arrayAsString(int[][] array)`. It should create a string representation of the array it receives as the parameter and return it.
Brush up on using StringBuilder in part 10.3 before taking on this exercise. Below there are a few examples of how the method is expected to  work.
